headline: Killamari glider
title: Killamari | Glide Longer With Fried Squid | Palworld Guide
video_script: Killamari has a funny partner skill in Palworld one point zero. It is called Fried Squid, and while Killamari is in your party, your equipped glider lets you float gently for much longer. It also works Transporting level two, with Watering and Gathering at level one. Do you glide a lot? Comment below!
description: Killamari in Palworld 1.0 lets your glider float for longer through its Fried Squid partner skill.
